title: S04 — Project Brief (2026-11-22)
body:
# Project Brief — S04 Action registry

## Outcome

One action declaration serves HTTP, MCP, OpenAPI, the admin CLI and external ingest: 549 actions
from a single registry, 580 served operations locked by hash.

## Boundary

Out of scope: the screens (S12), the board (S05) and the tool platform (T13). The registry must not
fork per transport; a second declaration path is a defect.

## Reuse sources

- `crates/actions/src/lib.rs` and `crates/actions-derive` — the ActionSpec declaration and macro.
- `crates/actions/src/invoke.rs` — the one invocation path with idempotency and audit.
- `crates/api/src/actions.rs` — the HTTP route over the same registry.
- `crates/actions/src/lock.rs` — the served-spec lock.

## Inception units

The gate analysis (derive, manifest, OpenAPI, MCP, invocation, ingest), the transport-parity
choice, and the lock's hash discipline are the inception units.

## Dependencies

S02 (the skeleton) and S03 (the domain schema); tranche 3; issue #3.

## Acceptance

`acceptance/programme/S04.toml` is the gate: the derive crate, the registry and the vocabularies,
the parity test, the lock check and the ingest round-trip.

## Capabilities

One declaration per action; one invocation path; one served spec; one external-ingest fold.

## Plan

Two deliverables — the ActionSpec derive crate and the registry and spec vocabularies — accepted
under change `01a2054b-3f86-7959-b2ad-f1edc5b0bb55`, credited at the tranche-3 demo, and closed
against the frozen baseline `01a20256-44d0-731d-b345-fffc5f3ac9e8`.
